items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: this guy Bill Fisher, he was producing an album for Herbie Mann... And he would let me play flute in the band

ctx.x: What a marvelous player and just his sound and everything.

He’s one of the greatest players of all time. And that happened, this guy Bill Fisher, he was producing an album for Herbie Mann called “Concerto in C Minor” it’s a red cover with a gold flute on it. And he would let me play flute in the band, even though I was playing percussion. So he suggested that I call Hubert Laws. He gave me a music directory, a musician’s directory, and I went to a pay phone. First I bought the album called “Flute By Laws,” and I went to a pay phone and his number was there and I called…
